final_repair_check.scope: R0 evidence-governance and documentation repairs only
final_repair_check.verification_summary: Source manifests passed with 35 files; all twelve futures sample rows remain manifest-bound and retrospective; q=0/no-action boundaries remain intact; source verifiers pass from repository and case roots.

findings.subject: ETF public-series basis contradicted downstream description
findings.initial_evidence: The frozen replay input declares price_basis=forward_adjusted_or_unknown, while downstream artifacts described it as unadjusted and price-only.
findings.required_repair: Reclassify the input as an unresolved-basis frozen public daily-bar series and regenerate all derived disclosures.

findings.subject: Six-date futures claims lacked all underlying raw files
findings.initial_evidence: The derived probe reported six sampled dates for each exchange, while the local source directory initially retained only the 2026-08-13 files.
findings.required_repair: Archive, hash and manifest all twelve raw samples or reduce the claim to one date.
findings.continuing_boundary: All historical samples were retrieved retrospectively on 2026-08-14 and do not establish original-date point-in-time availability.

findings.subject: Required R0 lifecycle artifacts were absent
findings.initial_evidence: The gate manifest required a finding set, repair-plan twins and review-log record, but none existed.
findings.required_repair: Create the lifecycle artifacts and rerun independent review; do not infer a pass from artifact existence.

findings.subject: Exploratory dynamic ETF diagnostic was called predeclared
findings.initial_evidence: The rulebook was explicitly draft/not frozen, but the interim memo described the dynamic diagnostic as predeclared.
findings.required_repair: Label it exploratory/post-source and prohibit formal-performance inference.

findings.subject: Vendor documentation manifest had incomplete per-file provenance
findings.initial_evidence: The batch was hash-bound, but individual records lacked publisher and explicit retrieval/effective-date convention and use boundary.
findings.required_repair: Normalize every vendor-document row while retaining its documentation-only status.

findings.subject: Futures diligence lacked distinct AU/CU/TA cards
findings.initial_evidence: The prior R1 file used a shared checklist instead of separate structure, missing-field and R2-gate treatment for each family.
findings.required_repair: Add separate cards that preserve unavailable rule fields rather than filling them with generic assumptions.

findings.subject: Failed AU/CU/PTA rule captures had no reproducible metadata record
findings.initial_evidence: The WAF/404 boundary was described in prose but lacked URL, attempt time, response classification and non-retention metadata.
findings.required_repair: Create a metadata-only failed-probe manifest without retaining challenge content.

findings.subject: Claim audit used opaque source-ID ranges
findings.initial_evidence: C07 stored source ranges rather than resolvable individual IDs.
findings.required_repair: Expand the IDs in the machine-readable claim audit.

findings.subject: Futures derived probe needed source-level and sample-level retrospective provenance
findings.initial_evidence: The source manifest disclosed retrospective retrieval, but the generated JSON/Markdown and its generator did not persist that boundary.
findings.required_repair: Persist retrieval_basis and manifest-derived retrieved_at in every sample and top-level provenance; refuse a regenerated result when its raw sample is absent from or differs from the manifest.

findings.subject: R0 verification tools needed cwd-independent source-path resolution
findings.initial_evidence: Repo-relative source paths could be resolved against the caller working directory rather than the repository root.
findings.required_repair: Anchor workspace paths to the repository root inferred from CASE_DIR and verify execution from both repository root and case root.

non_remediable_at_current_stage: UR01: authorized point-in-time ETF total-return/event archive
UR02: authorized point-in-time actual-contract futures archive
UR03: dated cost and execution evidence
UR05: independent review plus prospective paper reconciliation
current_decision: The case remains a non-investable evidence memo with q=0. A clean rerun can close the documentation defects only; it cannot make the strategy usable.
